title: A Quantum Coherence Corpus
author: Ethan James Farrell
description: A custom companion volume from Ethan's own Quantum Prayers project (June 2026 edition). It is a structured collection of coherence-aligned prayers arranged in 21 subject categories, drawing on and extending the framework set out in Quantum Prayers: Coherence, Consciousness and the Art of Aligned Prayer. The corpus opens with guidance on how to use it and a five-stage prayer protocol, then provides prayers built around the book's central metaphors: the observer effect, quantum coherence, non-locality and intention as an organising field. Categories cover everyday spiritual and practical needs such as healing, protection, relationships, guidance, gratitude and intercession. Written as a practical prayer book rather than a scientific treatise, it is intended for devotional use and as a source library of prayer texts for retrieval and composition by people and AI agents working within the Quantum Prayers framework.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
